title: Build a bakery model through MCP (an integer program)
prompt:
A bakery makes three products in whole batches: loaves, rolls and cakes. Profit per batch (euro) is 30, 18 and 45. Oven time per batch is 3, 1 and 4 hours, with 40 oven hours available; flour per batch is 5, 2 and 6 kg, with 70 kg available. At most 4 batches of cakes can be sold. Rolls batches may not exceed 1.5 times the loaves batches. Maximise the total profit.
Name the integer variables `loaves`, `rolls`, `cakes` (batches).

No model file is given: write the model yourself. Use the MCP tool build_model (the model as JSON) or load_model with LP text, then solve it. Report values at the full precision the solver returns.

End your final message with one line of the form
ANSWER: {"status": "<solution status string>", "objective": <number>, "plan": {"<variable name>": <value>, ...}}
where `plan` lists every decision variable named above by exactly the name given (zeros may be left out), and `status` is "Optimal" when the solver proves optimality.
